_comment: Premium PDF field guides sold on Gumroad, keyed by itinerary collection id. ItineraryGuideCard renders the paid-PDF card (all 5 langs) only while the itinerary's current stopsHash equals the stopsHash recorded here — the itinerary the PDF was built from (src/lib/guide-product.mjs). Regenerating the itinerary hides the card until the PDF is rebuilt and this hash updated. Price is display-only — the checkout price lives on Gumroad.
